name: Engine generators and the creative generator

pages.text: $(l)Generator on an engine$()$(br)Right-click a regular, radial or turbine engine with a $(item)generator$() to mount it as the engine's upgrade. An engine takes only one upgrade. The engine then feeds the network directly:

$(li)Voltage: $(item)20 x engine RPM / 500$().$(li)Power: $(item)1 W per engine RPM$().$(li)Engine torque is multiplied by $(item)0.7$().$(br2)At 4,000 engine RPM that gives 160 V and 4,000 W, on top of the rotation the engine still delivers. See the $(item)Engines$() chapter to build and fuel one.

$(l)Creative generator$()$(br)Available in creative mode only. Set its voltage with the value box on top, from $(item)0 to 2,500 V$() in steps of 10 V. Its power is practically unlimited and it never overloads itself. Use it to test a setup before building real generators, but remember that the other blocks on its network still have their own limits.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
